G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    colcnt=Counter(g[r][c] for r,c in cells)
    verts={p for p in cells if colcnt[g[p[0]][p[1]]]==1}
    rays=[p for p in cells if p not in verts]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # group ray cells into diagonal-adjacent components
